messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — embedding dims + rerank semantics came up in two customer cases. Need to lock API shape, SDK types, and docs before next release.
Mira Patel: What are the exact asks from customers?
Alex Chen: Acme wants a stable vector length reported per model family. Finlytics expects rerank scores normalized 0-1 and a short explain string. Also want migration docs.
Sam Ortiz: Implementation thoughts:
- Add an explicit `dimensions` int in embedding responses (populated from model metadata).
- For rerank: return `score` normalized 0..1 and `raw_score` for traceability, plus optional `explain`.
Paul Nguyen: TS types sketch:
```ts
export type EmbeddingResponse = {
  vector: number[];
  dimensions?: number;
  model_variant?: string;
}
export type RerankItem = {
  id: string;
  score: number; // 0..1
  raw_score?: number;
  explain?: string;
}
```
Jess R.: Docs: include a short migration note showing old payload vs new payload, and a code snippet for Py/TS that reads `dimensions` safely.
Sam Ortiz: Question: normalize server-side or provide normalization params? Normalizing server-side is friendlier but can mask changes between model versions.
Mira Patel: Product preference: server-side normalized `score` plus `raw_score`. Add a short algorithm note in docs and a link to RFC.
devex-bot: RFC opened: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/482-embed-rerank-compat — comments welcome.
Paul Nguyen: I'll add helper utilities in SDKs: `getVectorLength(resp)` in TS and a `dimensions` property+warning in Py if mismatch.
Jess R.: Examples need to cover streaming vs sync where applicable. For TS, one canonical `fetch` example with streaming covers many users.
Alex Chen: Proposed launch criteria:
- Embedding responses include `dimensions` and `model_variant` metadata
- Rerank returns `score` normalized 0..1 and `raw_score` optional
- SDKs (Py/TS) ship types + one short example each
- Docs include migration guide and changelog entry
Action items:
- Sam: implement fields behind feature flag — due Tue EOD (1848532800)
- Paul: PRs for TS + Py types & examples — due Wed
- Jess: migration guide + changelog blurb — due Thu
- Mira: decide priority slot in next roadmap sync
Sam Ortiz: I'll open the implementation PR and add tests for normalization edge cases.
Paul Nguyen: Starting TS PR now, will ping reviewers.
Jess R.: Drafting the docs and will include both short and expanded examples.
Mira Patel: Marking as medium priority; if there's enterprise customer pressure we bump. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Great, reconvene here when PRs land.
